features.name: Onboarding Service
features.description: Producers and distributors complete FBO attestation and onboarding, authenticated via an external-party identity provider, before they can trade on HarvestLink. FR-001.

features.name: Discovery & Matching Service
features.description: Foodservice buyers discover producers via compliance-completeness-driven search and matching. FR-002.

features.name: Traceability Service
features.description: Immutable, dual-signed traceability records for producer-distributor trades, at 99.9% availability per ES4. FR-003.

features.name: Compliance Documentation Service
features.description: Producers submit self-attested allergen declarations; drives the compliance-completeness score used elsewhere. FR-004.

features.name: Transaction Limit Enforcement Service
features.description: Server-side enforcement of transaction-value limits based on a producer's compliance-completeness score. FR-005.

features.name: Transaction Routing Service
features.description: Enforces facilitation-only routing so HarvestLink never records itself as taking possession or title of goods. FR-006.

features.name: Cohort Management Service
features.description: Restricts pilot-phase onboarding and trading to a designated cohort. FR-007.

features.name: Reporting Service
features.description: Publishes time-to-first-compliant-trade and compliance-completeness metrics to Snowflake via Kong API Gateway. FR-008, FR-009.

features.name: External-party identity provider integration
features.description: Newly surfaced gap: Azure AD is employee-only, so HarvestLink needs a separate external-party identity provider (e.g. Azure AD B2C, Auth0) for producer/distributor/buyer authentication.

features.name: Kong API Gateway routing configuration for HarvestLink
features.description: Mandatory per EA4: all HarvestLink API traffic (mobile app, external integrations, Snowflake publishing) must route through the existing Kong API Gateway (CI-APP-007).

features.name: Payment gateway integration
features.description: Third-party payment provider (not yet selected — e.g. Stripe, Adyen) required for the transaction flow enforced by Transaction Routing Service.
